card.name: F in Fehling's after Benedict's or
card.fires_on: The capital letter F that starts Fehling's solution, right after 'Benedict's or' in warnings about false-positive urine glucose tests. Weaker on word-start pieces like g in gout or Inf at the start of a sentence.

modes.label: Fehling's solution
modes.description: The F that begins Fehling's after Benedict's or in urine glucose test interference.
modes.example: A false-positive reaction may occur when testing for the presence of glucose in the urine using Benedict’s solution or<< F>>ehling’s solution.

modes.label: Sentence-start Inf
modes.description: The Inf piece that begins words like Infrequently, Infertility or Infants right after a full stop.
